name: Pose Yoga Studio
tagline: Small yoga classes seven days a week in a bright room on Alder Street. Every level, every body, no mirrors.
room_note: Twelve mats a class, so there is always room to spread out.

first_visit.text: Arrive ten minutes early so we can show you around.
Bring water. Mats, blocks, straps and blankets are here.
Tell your teacher about injuries or pregnancy — quietly is fine.
Showers and lockers are on the left past the front desk.

art_direction.identity: A bright neighbourhood yoga studio drawn like a pictogram system: chalk-white canvas, mist-teal panels, deep teal ink, studio-teal buttons, and every pose drawn as a numbered geometric figure — the studio's own notation.
art_direction.type: Funnel Display (weight 500, tight tracking) for every heading and number; Funnel Sans for body and UI. No serif, no italics. Headlines large and plain, set in sentence case.
art_direction.color: Studio teal (bg-primary / text-primary) for buttons, pictograms and links. Deep teal (bg-secondary) carries exactly one dark band — the intro offer. Chartreuse (bg-spark) is only for the pose being held in the sequence, the intro-offer tag, and the call to action on the dark band. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The sequence — Sun Salutation A drawn as numbered pictogram plates, a chartreuse highlight moving through them at breath pace with an Inhale / Exhale cue and a breathing ring. Every class carries its own pictogram; keep drawing new poses in the same grammar (a filled circle head, round-capped 4-unit strokes on a 48-unit grid).
art_direction.voice: Plain, warm and specific. Times, prices, names, what to bring. No 'journey', no 'sanctuary', no 'namaste', no exclamation marks.
